verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop documentation has an 'Install languages' topic, so localization is a first-party capability. The evidence is only a single table-of-contents entry, with no detail on how many languages are covered, how complete translations are, or who provides them. Missing for 10: documented range and completeness of language support, evidence of the official/community translation effort, hands-on corroboration that the desktop works well in non-English locales.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use the desktop in my own language thanks to community or official translations
